summary: Master hospitality financial management to improve margins, control costs, and build credible finance reports. Join the 5-day course today.
lede: Hospitality financial management helps professionals plan, monitor and improve the financial performance of hospitality operations. For teams in finance, rooms, food and beverage, revenue and procurement, it supports budgeting and forecasting, variance analysis, prime cost control, and tracking occupancy, ADR and RevPAR. Learners practice turning operating figures into variance reports, cash-control checks and dashboards, and use financial insights to shape action plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with hospitality operating numbers and need stronger control over revenue, cost, and reporting decisions. It suits practitioners, managers, specialists, and leaders across finance, rooms, food and beverage, revenue, and procurement functions.
outcomes: Cash Flow And Working Capital Analysis
prerequisites: Bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet tool, and be ready to work with sample hospitality financial data. A basic understanding of income statements, budgets, and operational reporting will help you move faster through the exercises.
